# CU — conditional-covariance-use role profile r0.5

Exact role: permission for one named covariance use on
'V_covariance(r) subset V_signal'. It binds role identity, population,
'h_pre', fixed 'P_C', scope, representation, units, validity, lifecycle, and
consumer action. Operational covariance and exact-GLS reference marginal
variance are separate. CU unavailability does not invalidate SP unless the
named use requires CU.
